entries.zh: 棘手的地方在于……（t 开头的形容词）

examples.en: The tricky part was keeping inventory consistent across three warehouses.
examples.zh: 棘手的地方在于让三个仓库的库存保持一致。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个项目里最难处理的是哪一块？
situation.en: The tricky part was handling refunds for orders that had already been partially shipped.

entries.note: 比 The difficult part 更口语，暗示“看着简单、做起来有坑”。讲通用难点时用现在时：The tricky part is ...

entries.zh: 边界情况（e 开头）

examples.en: We missed an edge case where the user's cart was empty at checkout.
examples.zh: 我们漏掉了一种边界情况：用户结算时购物车是空的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个功能测试都过了，为什么上线后还会出 bug？
situation.en: There was an edge case we hadn't covered: orders placed exactly at midnight got the wrong date.

entries.note: 指输入或条件处在边界上的情况，是最通用的说法。

entries.zh: 很偏的边角情况（c 开头，多个边界条件同时出现）

examples.en: It was a corner case that only showed up when a refund and a retry happened together.
examples.zh: 这是个很偏的边角情况，只有退款和重试同时发生时才会出现。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那个 bug 为什么测试阶段没发现？你想说它太偏了，要几个条件同时满足才会触发。
situation.en: It was a real corner case. The user had to change currency while a payment was still pending.

entries.note: 和 edge case 常混用。严格说 corner case 更偏，指几个边界条件叠在一起才触发。

entries.zh: 很难复现

examples.en: The bug was hard to reproduce because it only happened under heavy load.
examples.zh: 这个 bug 很难复现，因为只在高负载下才出现。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那个线上问题为什么查了那么久？
situation.en: It was hard to reproduce locally. It only showed up in production, maybe once in ten thousand requests.

entries.note: 口语里 reproduce 常缩成 repro：I can't repro it.（我复现不了。）

entries.zh: 和……耦合得很紧（t 开头的副词 + 过去分词 + to）

examples.en: The order service was tightly coupled to the old billing database.
examples.zh: 订单服务和老的计费数据库耦合得很紧。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那个模块为什么那么难改？
situation.en: The pricing logic was tightly coupled to the checkout page, so every small change meant touching both.

entries.note: 名词说法是 tight coupling：There was tight coupling between A and B. 反义是 loosely coupled。

entries.zh: （费了一番功夫）追查到、找出问题的源头（t 开头的短语动词）

examples.en: It took us two days to track down the source of the duplicate orders.
examples.zh: 我们花了两天才追查到重复订单的源头。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那个偶发的数据不一致，你们最后是怎么定位的？
situation.en: We added more logging and finally tracked it down to a retry in the payment client.

entries.note: 代词要放中间：track it down。后面接 to 说明查到了哪里。

entries.zh: 结果发现……（讲排查结果的句型，含 turn 的过去式）

examples.en: It turned out that the timestamps were stored in local time, not UTC.
examples.zh: 结果发现，时间戳存的是本地时间，不是 UTC。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那最后查出来原因是什么？
situation.en: It turned out that two services were using different rounding rules for the same price.

entries.note: 讲故事时的转折句，表示“查了半天，真相和预想的不一样”。也可以说 It turned out to be a time zone issue.

entries.zh: 不简单、有相当难度的（否定前缀 + “琐碎的”）

examples.en: Migrating ten years of order data without downtime was non-trivial.
examples.zh: 把十年的订单数据不停机迁过去，可不是件简单的事。

situation.zh: 面试官问：听起来只是加个字段，为什么排了三周？
situation.en: It sounds simple, but the change was non-trivial because five downstream systems read that table.

entries.note: 工程师的含蓄说法，实际意思往往是“相当难”。反过来，trivial 指“很简单、不值一提”。

entries.zh: 很难做对、很难做到位（四个词，含 get）

examples.en: Time zone handling is surprisingly hard to get right.
examples.zh: 时区处理出乎意料地难做对。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你觉得退款这块业务难在哪？
situation.en: Partial refunds are hard to get right, because tax and discounts have to be split correctly.

entries.note: get ... right 表示把某件事做对：It took us three tries to get the rounding right.

entries.zh: （没法根治，先想办法）绕开问题或限制（w 开头的短语动词）

examples.en: We worked around the API limit by batching requests on our side.
examples.zh: 我们在自己这边把请求合并成批，绕开了接口的调用限制。

situation.zh: 面试官问：第三方接口不支持你们要的功能，你们是怎么办的？
situation.en: We couldn't change their API, so we worked around it by caching the results ourselves.

entries.note: 名词是一个词 workaround：It's a temporary workaround, not a real fix.

entries.zh: 下单（p 开头的动词）

examples.en: When a user places an order, we reserve the stock before taking payment.
examples.zh: 用户下单时，我们先预占库存，再扣款。

situation.zh: 面试官问：讲一下用户点“提交订单”之后，后端发生了什么。
situation.en: When a customer places an order, we validate the cart, lock the price, and create a pending order.

entries.note: 说的是用户的动作，不说 make an order。系统这边“创建订单”说 create an order。

entries.zh: 结算流程（从购物车到支付完成的那一段）

examples.en: We redesigned the checkout flow and cut it from five steps to two.
examples.zh: 我们重新设计了结算流程，从五步减到两步。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你在电商团队主要负责哪部分？你负责的是从购物车到付款成功的那段流程。
situation.en: I owned the checkout flow, from the cart page all the way to payment confirmation.

entries.note: check out 是动词（两个词），checkout 是名词或形容词（一个词）。

entries.zh: 购物车

examples.en: We store the shopping cart on the server so it syncs across devices.
examples.zh: 我们把购物车存在服务端，这样可以跨设备同步。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户没登录时加购的商品，登录后怎么处理？
situation.en: We merge the anonymous shopping cart into the user's account as soon as they log in.

entries.note: 平时常简称 cart，英式英语多说 basket。加购是 add to cart，加了没买是 abandon the cart。

entries.zh: 订单生命周期（从创建到完成的全过程）

examples.en: We modeled the order lifecycle as a state machine with explicit transitions.
examples.zh: 我们把订单生命周期建模成一个状态机，状态流转都是显式定义的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：订单有那么多状态，你们怎么保证不会出现非法的状态跳转？
situation.en: We treat the order lifecycle as a state machine, so an order can only move along allowed transitions.

entries.note: “状态流转”说 state transition，“状态机”说 state machine。

entries.zh: 履约（订单付款后拣货、发货、送达的环节）

examples.en: Once payment is confirmed, the order moves on to fulfillment.
examples.zh: 付款确认之后，订单就进入履约环节。

situation.zh: 面试官问：付款成功之后，订单接下来由哪个环节处理？
situation.en: After payment, the order is handed off to fulfillment, which covers picking, packing, and shipping.

entries.note: 动词是 fulfill an order。英式拼写是 fulfilment。

entries.zh: 扣减库存（d 开头的动词 + i 开头的名词）

examples.en: We deduct inventory when the order is paid, not when it's created.
examples.zh: 我们在订单支付时扣减库存，而不是在创建订单时。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们是下单时扣库存，还是付款时扣？
situation.en: We deduct inventory at payment time, and only hold it temporarily when the order is created.

entries.note: 也常说 decrement the stock（把库存数减掉）。inventory 和 stock 在这里可以互换。

entries.zh: 超卖（一个词，动词）

examples.en: A race condition in the stock check caused us to oversell a popular item.
examples.zh: 库存校验里有个竞态条件，导致一款热门商品超卖了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：秒杀场景下最怕出什么问题？
situation.en: The worst case is that we oversell: we accept more orders than we actually have stock for.

entries.note: 过去式是 oversold。名词用 overselling：We had to prevent overselling.

entries.zh: 缺货、没货了（介词短语，三个词）

examples.en: The page still showed the item as available, but it was actually out of stock.
examples.zh: 页面上还显示有货，实际上已经缺货了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：库存缓存和数据库不一致时，用户会遇到什么情况？
situation.en: Users could add an item to the cart and only find out it was out of stock at checkout.

entries.note: 反义是 in stock（有货）。卖光了也说 sold out。

entries.zh: 预占库存（r 开头的动词 + i 开头的名词）

examples.en: We reserve inventory for fifteen minutes while the user completes payment.
examples.zh: 用户付款期间，我们把库存预占十五分钟。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户下了单但还没付款，这段时间库存怎么处理？
situation.en: We reserve inventory when the order is created, so nobody else can buy it during payment.

entries.note: 也说 hold the stock、put a hold on the inventory。名词是 an inventory reservation。

entries.zh: 释放（预占的）库存

examples.en: If the payment times out, a background job cancels the order and releases the inventory.
examples.zh: 如果支付超时，后台任务会取消订单并释放库存。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户下单后一直不付款，占着的库存怎么办？
situation.en: We cancel unpaid orders after fifteen minutes and release the inventory back to the pool.

entries.note: 和 reserve 是一对：预占之后要么确认扣减，要么释放。

entries.zh: 支付渠道、支付服务商（第二个词 pro 开头，字面是“提供方”）

examples.en: We integrated with three payment providers to cover different regions.
examples.zh: 我们对接了三家支付渠道，覆盖不同地区。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们的支付是自己做的，还是接的第三方？
situation.en: We don't process cards ourselves. We go through a payment provider and route each payment by region.

entries.note: 国内说的“支付渠道”，英文常说 payment provider 或 payment service provider（PSP）。payment gateway 指负责接入的那层网关。直译成 payment channel 对方不一定能懂。

entries.zh: 支付结果回调（渠道主动通知我们，第二个词 w 开头）

examples.en: We treat the payment webhook as the source of truth, not the browser redirect.
examples.zh: 我们以支付回调为准，而不是以浏览器跳转为准。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户付完款直接关了页面，你们怎么知道支付成功了？
situation.en: We rely on the payment webhook from the provider, and we also poll in case it never arrives.

entries.note: 国内说的“回调”，在支付场景里英文多说 webhook。说 callback 对方也能懂，比如 callback URL。

entries.zh: 重复扣款（d 开头，两个词）

examples.en: A retry bug caused a double charge for about two hundred customers.
examples.zh: 一个重试的 bug 导致大约两百位用户被重复扣款。

situation.zh: 面试官问：支付接口超时后直接重试，会有什么风险？
situation.en: The risk is a double charge: the first request may have gone through even though it timed out.

entries.note: 也可以作动词：We double-charged some customers. 或者说 charge the customer twice。

entries.zh: 发起退款（i 开头的动词）

examples.en: Support agents can issue a refund directly from the admin panel.
examples.zh: 客服可以直接在后台发起退款。

situation.zh: 面试官问：发现重复扣款之后，你们怎么处理受影响的用户？
situation.en: We identified the affected orders with a script and issued a refund for each one within a day.

entries.note: 全额退款是 full refund，部分退款是 partial refund。refund 也可以直接作动词：refund the customer。

entries.zh: 对账、核对两边的记录（动词）

examples.en: Every night we reconcile our orders against the provider's settlement report.
examples.zh: 每天晚上，我们拿自己的订单和渠道的结算报表对账。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么发现“用户付了钱但订单没更新”这类问题？
situation.en: A nightly job reconciles our payment records with the provider's, and flags anything that doesn't match.

entries.note: reconcile A with B 或 against B。重音在第一个音节。名词是 reconciliation，它在 React 里是另一个意思（协调）。

entries.zh: （两边数据）对不上的地方、差异（d 开头）

examples.en: We found a discrepancy of a few cents between our records and the bank's.
examples.zh: 我们发现自己的记录和银行的记录差了几分钱。

situation.zh: 面试官问：对账时两边金额不一致，你们怎么处理？
situation.en: Any discrepancy goes into a review queue, and someone on the finance team resolves it by hand.

entries.note: 比 difference 更正式，专指“本该一致却不一致”。复数是 discrepancies。

entries.zh: 账本、资金流水账（l 开头）

examples.en: Every balance change is recorded as an entry in an append-only ledger.
examples.zh: 每一笔余额变动，都作为一条记录写进只追加的账本。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么保证用户余额不会算错，出了问题还能查？
situation.en: We never update balances in place. Every movement of money is an entry in the ledger.

entries.note: 讲资金安全时很常用：余额由流水算出来，而不是直接改。double-entry ledger 是复式记账的账本。

entries.zh: 拒付（持卡人通过发卡行把钱追回，一个词）

examples.en: We lost several chargeback disputes because we couldn't prove delivery.
examples.zh: 有好几笔拒付争议我们都输了，因为没法证明货已送达。

situation.zh: 面试官问：做海外信用卡支付，有什么国内业务不太会遇到的问题？
situation.en: Chargebacks were a big one. A cardholder can dispute a charge with their bank months after the purchase.

entries.note: 和 refund 不同：refund 是商家主动退，chargeback 是持卡人找银行强制追回，商家通常还要付手续费。

entries.zh: 欺诈识别、（支付）风控（f 开头）

examples.en: Our fraud detection flagged the order because the shipping address kept changing.
examples.zh: 我们的风控系统标记了这笔订单，因为收货地址一直在变。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么防止盗刷？
situation.en: We run every payment through fraud detection, which scores it on device, location, and order history.

entries.note: 国内说的“风控”，在支付语境里英文多说 fraud detection 或 fraud prevention，负责的团队常叫 the risk team。

entries.zh: 合规要求

examples.en: The compliance requirements were different in every country we expanded to.
examples.zh: 我们每进入一个国家，合规要求都不一样。

situation.zh: 面试官问：为什么你们不自己存用户的银行卡号？
situation.en: Mostly because of compliance requirements. Under PCI DSS, storing card numbers puts far more of your system in scope for audits.

entries.note: 形容词是 compliant：be PCI compliant、be compliant with GDPR。讲支付和数据隐私时常用。

entries.zh: 秒杀、限时抢购

examples.en: During a flash sale, traffic can jump to fifty times the normal level within seconds.
examples.zh: 秒杀期间，流量可能在几秒内涨到平时的五十倍。

examples.en: Before each flash sale, we preload the stock counts into Redis.
examples.zh: 每次秒杀前，我们会把库存数预热到 Redis 里。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你做过的并发最高的业务场景是什么？
situation.en: That would be our flash sales, where thousands of users compete for a few hundred items in the same second.

entries.note: 英文里没有和“秒杀”完全对应的词，flash sale 最接近，必要时补一句解释规则。

entries.zh: 流量洪峰、流量激增（第二个词 su 开头，像浪一样涌来）

examples.en: We put a queue in front of the order service to absorb the traffic surge.
examples.zh: 我们在订单服务前面加了一个队列，来承接流量洪峰。

situation.zh: 面试官问：活动开始那一瞬间，系统最大的压力来自哪里？
situation.en: The traffic surge at the start: everyone hits the buy button within the same few seconds.

entries.note: 也说 a surge in traffic。surge 强调突然涌来的一大波。

entries.zh: 热点商品（两个词，第二个词 i 开头）

examples.en: A single hot item can take up most of the traffic during a sale.
examples.zh: 大促期间，一个热点商品就可能占掉大部分流量。

situation.zh: 面试官问：为什么秒杀商品的库存不能直接走普通的下单流程？
situation.en: Because every request hits the same row. For a hot item, we keep the stock counter in Redis instead.

entries.note: 也说 hot product、hot SKU。技术上对应的是热点 key（hot key）问题。

entries.zh: 限购（每人最多买几件的限制）

examples.en: We enforce a purchase limit of two items per account during the sale.
examples.zh: 活动期间，我们限制每个账号最多买两件。

situation.zh: 面试官问：怎么防止一个人把秒杀商品全抢光？
situation.en: We set a purchase limit per user, and we check it on the server, not just in the UI.

entries.zh: （高峰期让用户排队等候的）排队页，字面是“等候室”

examples.en: We put users in a virtual waiting room and let them in batch by batch.
examples.zh: 我们把用户放进一个虚拟排队页，再一批一批放进来。

situation.zh: 面试官问：流量远超系统容量时，你们怎么不让系统被打垮？
situation.en: We send users to a waiting room first, and only admit as many as the backend can handle.

entries.note: 也叫 virtual waiting room 或 virtual queue，用户看到的是“您正在排队”的页面。
